trap.label: Were I to
trap.wrong: If I was you, I would ask.
trap.right: Were I you, I would ask.
trap.why: Em português usamos “se eu fosse”. Em inglês formal/hipotético, com inversão use Were (não was) com todos os sujeitos.

mcq.q: ___ I to design a study, I would ask first.

fix.wrong: Was I to design a study, I would ask.
fix.right: Were I to design a study, I would ask.

fix.wrong: Were I to designing a study, I would ask.
fix.right: Were I to design a study, I would ask.

fix.wrong: If it was not for you, I’d fail.
fix.right: If it were not for you, I’d fail.

rewrite.prompt: Inverta: “If I were to design a study, I would ask first.”
rewrite.answer: Were I to design a study, I would ask first.

rewrite.prompt: Inverta: “If she were here, she would help.”
rewrite.answer: Were she here, she would help.

rewrite.prompt: Inverta: “If it were not for volunteers, we would fail.”
rewrite.answer: Were it not for volunteers, we would fail.
